name: explore-solo
description: Explore Solo - sistem reservasi destinasi wisata Kota Surakarta (React + Express + MySQL)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
